rules.statement: The Court should remit the case to the lower court for further evidence regarding the due execution of certain deeds, particularly Deed No. 11385.
rules.supporting_quote: In all the circumstances it is, in my opinion, desirable that the pro�ceedings should be remitted to the Court below to enable the plaintiff to produce the duplicate of Deed No. 11385 which is in the custody of the Registrar of Lands.
